title: Orca_Protocol
tagline: Horizon AI – an autonomous trading platform that uses AI to execute trades and generate profits seamlessly.
description:
Horizon AI is a state-of-the-art trading platform designed to automate trading decisions, allowing users to generate profits effortlessly. Users can either configure their agents manually or leverage AI to create a trading agent tailored to their specific needs. Once set up, the agent autonomously executes trades.

During the demo, our agent successfully completed its first trade, achieving a 100% success rate. Users can view all their agents on a dedicated page and track real-time performance through a comprehensive dashboard, which presents key trading metrics and insights.
how_its_made:
Horizon AI integrates cutting-edge technologies to deliver an intelligent and efficient trading experience. The platform leverages AI-driven decision-making algorithms for trade execution and incorporates a seamless user interface. It utilizes CDP AgentKit to enable autonomous trading strategies, allowing users to deploy agents that analyze market trends and execute trades optimally. Users can interact with the system through a structured dashboard that provides an overview of all trading activities.  

By combining automation with real-time analytics and CDP AgentKit's capabilities, Horizon AI empowers users to trade efficiently without constant manual intervention.
